title: Older brother June, a natural drummer, wins a contest
summary: An older brother, June, played drums untrained and won a theater contest in Columbus, praised by Chick Webb.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: And you had another brother, too.
I had an older brother, was two years older than I, and he passed in his late teens. He passed, and he was talented...
He played drums, and a very good drummer. I remember very distinctly that, I guess I was about 15, 16 years old, Chick Webb had come to town with his band...

We were in Columbus, Ohio at that time. You see, during that period that we had left Indianapolis to go to Columbus, and I'll tell you a little bit more about that, but...Chick Webb had come to town and there was a contest going on, and he was there to perform this contest...
...in a theater. You know, just youngsters, and he won the contest.

Yeah, right. I remember Chick Webb, being a drummer, that he would sort of praise him for his drumming, for his work as a drummer, but he wasn't what you would call an educated drummer. Just a youngster with natural talent, an expression, not a schooled drummer.
Did he just pick it up?
Oh yeah, he didn't have any background, training; he just picked it up. It was something he wanted to do.
